name: Flag a flaky job's first failure
description: Every 10 minutes it looks at the repository's failed pull request runs. A workflow you name that failed on its first attempt is told once to the leader, with the run's link and a line saying to re-run it. It starts nothing itself: a person or an agent re-runs the job. A run is told once: it counts as seen the first time.

repo.title: Repository
repo.description: The GitHub repository to watch, as owner/name.

credential.title: Vault entry
credential.description: The id of the Vault entry that holds a GitHub token that can read the repository's runs. The first call asks you once; the token goes only to api.github.com.

workflow.title: The flaky workflow
workflow.description: The workflow's name as GitHub shows it, such as CI. Leave out quote marks.

leader.title: Who to tell
leader.description: The id of the agent that gets one line for each first failure.
